verdict.rationale: Llama's weights are downloadable through the official llama-models CLI and the meta-llama Hugging Face org, in both Meta and transformers formats. First-party docs cover running it locally on Windows, macOS and Linux, on mobile and edge devices via ExecuTorch, and on varied hardware via llama.cpp. Community posts confirm commercial self-hosted use, though large models such as Llama 4 need substantial VRAM or unified memory. Missing for 10: ungated download (access needs request approval and license acceptance), an unrestricted license (Community License with a 700M MAU clause, not OSI open source), and independent hands-on reports of a full self-hosting setup.
